Gold can also buy Epic-legendary

# Blending:

* For 30 Bronze = 1 Silver

* For 10 Silver + 100 Bronze = 1 Gold

* you can blend for in Epic-Legendary NFTs

*Blending Silver and Gold will be start 10 minutes after the bronze sale starting 

# [Blend Here](https://neftyblocks.com/c/cryptosoltan/blends/232891)

# Soltanium Supply:

* Special Gold: 999 mints

* Special Silver: 9,999 mints

* Special Bronze: unlimited supply, will be realized in batches of 99,999 mints.

# Distribution Plan:
>  There will be two drops of the first batch
>   [Atomicdrops](https://wax.atomichub.io/drops/79214) and [NeftyBlocks](https://neftyblocks.com/c/cryptosoltan/drops/24184) 
> Each batch sale will end in one week
